violation_type.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver
violation_type.typical_finding: A high school student was observed to alone supervising children during restroom time.

finding_variants.text: A high school student was observed to alone supervising children during restroom time.
A caregiver under the age of 18 was observed caring for children unsupervised without a qualified caregiver.
The operation has a high school student assigned as the office manager and closer of the infant building.

A 17 yr old caregiver who currently attends high school was observed to be left unsupervised with a group of children multiple times. The supervising caregiver was observed to be going back and forth between the kitchen and classroom.
Based on the Preponderance of evidence found during the DFPS investigation, a center employee younger than 18 years old was alone in a classroom with a group of children.
During the investigation it was found children were in the care of an unqualified caregiver without direct supervision of a qualified caregiver.
